title: Short QQQ — CPI Muddle-Through Drives Silent September Hike Repricing
entry: $705–715. Short at open or any intraday rally above $710 on CPI day. The STEP ASIDE verdict means cash is already held — this short captures the downside tail in the muddle-through scenario without requiring large position size. Do NOT enter if CPI ≤3.5% is confirmed at 8:30 AM — the BUY upgrade scenario makes this short immediately wrong.
stop_loss: $727 daily close (~2.8% above $707 midpoint) — a close at $727 implies CPI printed ≤3.5% AND Warsh testimony was explicitly dovish, triggering the BUY upgrade scenario in the morning briefing. Exit before the close if CPI ≤3.5% is confirmed at 8:30 AM ET — do not wait for end of day.
targets: $690 — CPI prints 3.7–3.9% (muddle-through) and Warsh is balanced but not dovish; September hike probability drifts from 60% to 65–70% over 1 week; AI multiple compression begins as rates hold; $690 corresponds to NQ retracing to the July 7 support zone; cover 50% of position; +2.4% short gain from $707 entry

$672 — Second week of rate creep: WTI sustaining above $78 begins loading into August CPI expectations; Warsh gives additional testimony or speech interpreted as hike-leaning; 10Y tests 4.70%; QQQ retests the June 26 consolidation low; cover 40% of position; +5.0% short gain

$651 — Bear case confirmation: CPI ≥3.9% OR Warsh signals a live July 28 meeting in Congressional testimony; broad market risk-off with VIX above 17; QQQ tests July support level from the May 2026 baseline; hold final 10% as tail protection; +8.0% short gain
catalyst: June CPI printing at or above consensus 3.8% (FactSet range 3.75–3.90%) creates the muddle-through scenario where September hike probability drifts silently higher over 2 weeks without an acute catalyst. Warsh's debut House testimony at 10 AM ET arrives with the Fed's revised 3.6% 2026 inflation forecast — already above the expected print — setting a hawkish floor for rate language regardless of the CPI outcome.
thesis:
The morning briefing explicitly identifies the muddle-through CPI outcome (~3.8%, consensus) as the most dangerous scenario for equities: no acute shock to force re-hedging, no BUY signal to act on, and no catastrophic catalyst to exit around — just a slow drain as September hike probability drifts from 60% to 70% over two weeks, gradually compressing AI multiples without a clean entry or exit signal.

QQQ at $707 is trading at peak AI multiple territory (34–37x forward earnings for the Mag-7 that dominate the index). A 10-percentage-point increase in September hike probability (from 60% to 70%) corresponds to approximately a 3–4% discount rate shock to long-duration tech earnings — precisely the 2.4% QQQ decline that gets the stock to Target1 ($690). The BTC 24h low of $61,821 (Gate 2 breach) this morning is the real-time leading indicator: the 24/7 crypto market is already pricing the muddle-through macro scenario more honestly than the equity market's muted overnight print.

The sector rotation component reinforces the short. Banks are beating earnings broadly (JPM +9.84%, BAC +14.2% revenue YoY, GS +44% EPS) while tech faces the muddle-through headwind. Institutional money rotates toward XLF, away from QQQ, with every bank earnings beat during a session where QQQ underperforms. That rotation pressure is a structural headwind requiring no macro shock — it just requires the CPI not to deliver a bull surprise.

The 1–2 week horizon is deliberate. This is not a structural bear position on QQQ. If CPI surprises to the downside (≤3.5%) or Warsh is explicitly dovish, exit immediately — the BUY upgrade scenario would force QQQ recovery above $730 within days. This is a tactical short capturing the high-probability base case of 'no relief on rates today,' held for the 2-week window before the July 29–30 FOMC and the megacap earnings (META, GOOGL, AMZN, MSFT all July 29–30).
bull_case: CPI ≤3.5% triggers BUY upgrade at 9:31 AM open; QQQ breaks above $730 on relief rally; Warsh's testimony is balanced and markets price a September pause. Cover immediately — the short is wrong from inception in this scenario.
bear_case: CPI 3.7–3.9% + Warsh non-committal + WTI approaching $80 = a three-week rate-creep from today. QQQ bleeds to $672–690 on no specific catalyst, compressing AI multiples as institutional money waits for the July 29–30 FOMC to clarify the September path. VIX remains subdued (no panic) but SPX slowly loses the 7,490 level.
invalidation: $727 QQQ daily close; OR CPI ≤3.5% confirmed at 8:30 AM (close immediately at 9:31 AM open before the full BUY rally materializes); OR Warsh explicitly signals no July 28–29 meeting rate hike AND references September as the earliest live meeting (dovish floor established, rate premium compresses); OR QQQ closes above the July 10 high on volume above the 30-day average (institutional accumulation signals wrong-sided short).
